text:
marie: Quick syncproposing a compact onboarding flow: fast smoke (<=4m) + async prober (<=2h). Smoke must be deterministic and fail fast.

dan: Agreed. Smoke checklist idea: handshake validation (schema_version, vocab_digest, max_seq, kv_flag), tokenization parity on core set, and a KV warmup run to check cache shapes. If any missing metadata -> immediate reject.

kai: For prober, emit signed artifacts: manifest.json (model_digest, tokenizer_digest, bench_version, seed), metrics.json (p50/p95, cost_est, quality_scores), and samples/ for failing cases. Store under s3://onboard-artifacts/<mid>/runs/<id> with 90d retention.

marie: UX: intake returns {smoke:pass/warn/fail, prober:queued/complete, artifact_link}. Keep messages actionable e.g. "vocab_mismatch: expected sha256:X got sha256:Y".

dan: Sampling hybrid: deterministic core + seeded fuzz per bucket (short/med/long). Add batch-size KV test [1,4,16] to catch padding transpose issues.

kai: Failure codes: VOCAB_MISMATCH, TOKEN_DRIFT, KV_SHAPE, LATENCY_P95, QUALITY_DROP, RESOURCE_OOM. Each maps to remediation hints in the response.

bench-bot: AUTO: prober queued for model 'mini-test' (mid: m-900). ETA ~80m. Will post compact JSON to #eng-ml/bench-results when done.

marie: Next steps: dan -> smoke CLI + KV warmup script (due Wed), kai -> manifest schema + signing shim (due Thu). We'll iterate thresholds in RFC update. :thumbsup:
